title: Defining unique structural features in the MAFA and MAFB transcription factors that control Insulin gene activity.
authors: Cha, Jeeyeon; Tong, Xin; Coate, Katie C; Guo, Min; Liu, Jin-Hua; Reynolds, Garrett; Walker, Emily M; Stein, Richard A; Mchaourab, Hassane; Stein, Roland
one_liner_zh: 该文结合X射线晶体结构突变与AlphaFold 2结构预测，研究MAFA/MAFB转录因子与DNA接触位点及C端结构差异对Insulin基因活性的影响，属TF-DNA互作机制研究，AI结构预测方法可借鉴，但未涉及结合位点预测或动态模拟。
abstract: MAFA and MAFB are related basic-leucine-zipper domain-containing transcription factors which have important overlapping and distinct regulatory roles in a variety of cellular contexts, including hormone production in pancreatic islet cells. Here, we first examined how mutating conserved MAF protein-DNA contact sites obtained from X-ray crystal structure analysis impacted their DNA-binding and Insulin enhancer-driven activity. While most of these interactions were essential and their disruption severely compromised activity, we identified that regions outside of these contact sites also contributed to transcriptional activity. AlphaFold 2 (https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk), an artificial intelligence-based structural prediction program, was used to determine if there were also differences in the three-dimensional organization of the non-DNA binding/dimerization sequences of MAFA and MAFB. This analysis was conducted on the WT proteins as well as the pathogenic MAFA(Ser64Phe) and MAFB(Ser70Ala) transactivation domain mutants, with differences revealed between MAFA(WT) and MAFB(WT) as well as between MAFA(Ser64Phe) and MAFA(WT), but not between MAFB(Ser70Ala) and MAFB(WT). Moreover, dissimilarities between these proteins were also observed in their ability to cooperatively stimulate Insulin enhancer-driven activity in the presence of other islet-enriched transcription factors. Analysis of MAFA and MAFB chimeras disclosed that these properties were influenced by their unique C-terminal region structural differences predicted by AlphaFold 2. Our findings have revealed key structural features of these closely related proteins that impact their ability to regulate gene expression.
abstract_zh: MAFA和MAFB是相关的含有碱性亮氨酸拉链结构域的转录因子，在多种细胞环境中具有重要且重叠及独特的调控作用，包括胰岛细胞中的激素产生。在此，我们首先研究了从X射线晶体结构分析中获得的保守MAF蛋白-DNA接触位点的突变如何影响其DNA结合及胰岛素增强子驱动的活性。虽然这些相互作用中的大多数是必需的，且其破坏严重损害了活性，但我们发现这些接触位点之外的区域也对转录活性有所贡献。使用AlphaFold 2（https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk），一种基于人工智能的结构预测程序，来确定MAFA和MAFB的非DNA结合/二聚化序列在三维组织上是否存在差异。该分析针对野生型（WT）蛋白以及致病性MAFA(Ser64Phe)和MAFB(Ser70Ala)反式激活结构域突变体进行，结果显示MAFA(WT)与MAFB(WT)之间以及MAFA(Ser64Phe)与MAFA(WT)之间存在差异，但MAFB(Ser70Ala)与MAFB(WT)之间未观察到差异。此外，这些蛋白在与其他胰岛富集转录因子共存时协同刺激胰岛素增强子驱动活性的能力上也观察到差异。对MAFA和MAFB嵌合体的分析揭示，这些特性受其独特的C端区域结构差异影响，该差异由AlphaFold 2预测得出。我们的发现揭示了这些密切相关蛋白的关键结构特征，这些特征影响其调控基因表达的能力。
